name: Manila
industries: BPO and global shared services lead, with banking digitisation and infrastructure programmes adding demand.
intro:
Manila's BPO and shared-services industry employs over a million people, and its career ladder has a clear rung where certification becomes mandatory: the move from team lead to programme or delivery manager. Employers across BGC, Makati and Ortigas reimburse PMP and Scrum courses because certified managers are what clients contractually require. Beyond outsourcing, the banks' digitisation race and the government's infrastructure push add steady demand. Our live online weekend batch runs on the IST schedule, converting to 11:30 AM – 8:30 PM Philippine time — no EDSA traffic, no leave forms, one weekend. English-language instruction with an international cohort matches the global-client environment Manila professionals already work in. Afterwards you get exam application guidance, realistic full-length mocks, and direct trainer access for doubts until you clear the exam.

Manila's delivery industry is globally wired: the BPO and shared-services floors of BGC, Makati and Ortigas run projects for clients in every timezone, and team leads who carry recognized certifications move up the account structure faster because clients see the credential on proposals. Domestic banks and conglomerates add a second demand stream with their own modernization programs. Training runs live online across two days, with session times on this page shown for Manila; weekend cohorts protect production schedules. Salary progression in Manila is steep between delivery tiers — use the sourced Manila entries below to see what certified roles actually command. The employer list reflects the BPO-bank-conglomerate hiring base, and delivery centres can certify team leads at scale through private cohorts.

faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Manila. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from Philippines?
